All samples (262 samples) were further filtered by three human annotators to maintain quality, resulting in 180 final transcriptions. Three human annotators are all from our co-authors of this paper (2 faculty members and 1 PhD student, all with expertises in NLP).

Annotators filtered samples based on content being low-risk, correct mapping to the risk label, and overall speech quality.

The annotators work independently and do not have access to each other's annotation results during the process to avoid undesired biases. A sample is removed if at least two annotators find it low quality.
